basic_profile.bio: I'm a 31-year-old tech enthusiast from Austin, Texas. I work as an embedded systems engineer and spend my free time exploring new gadgets and technologies. When I'm not tinkering with tech, I enjoy listening to classic rock on SiriusXM and catching up on the latest discussions in the FPGA community. I'm single and enjoy the flexibility my lifestyle offers. I usually browse Reddit during late evenings after work.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in electrical engineering with a focus on embedded systems. Most of my expertise comes from my work experience and self-teaching through online courses and forums. I'm particularly interested in FPGA technology and ARM architecture.
